inv-2026-0881.title: Investigate -32.4% Sales Decline in Audio Category (Week 42)
inv-2026-0881.summary: Sales dropped $248,500 (-32.4% WoW). Agent evaluated 4 competing hypotheses. Root cause proven: Stockout of flagship SKU-409 & SKU-412 caused by 9-day port delay on Supplier PO-88321, not demand drop or marketing channel failure.

timeline.title: Incident Detected & Problem Frame Defined
timeline.description: Identified -32.4% sales drop in Audio category between Oct 14-21 compared to 6-week rolling baseline.

timeline.title: Cross-Source Schema Mapping via Zetaris
timeline.description: Federated query across Sales Transactions, Warehouse Inventory (WMS), and Supplier EDI.

timeline.title: Competing Hypotheses Generated
timeline.description: Structured 4 hypotheses: (1) Out of Stock, (2) Supplier Delivery Failure, (3) Demand Collapse, (4) Promo Anomaly.

timeline.title: Evidence Gathering & Fact Distinction
timeline.description: Extracted 6 source records. Verified traffic did not decline (+4.2% visits), eliminating demand collapse hypothesis.

timeline.title: Causal Chain Grounding & Action Formulation
timeline.description: Correlated Supplier PO-88321 delay (+9 days) directly to inventory depletion on Oct 16. Formulated mitigation.

timeline.title: Human Review & Action Approval Gate
timeline.description: Recommended expedited supplier shipment and regional safety-stock redistribution awaiting human sign-off.

hypotheses.title: Critical Stockout of Top-Tier Revenue Drivers
hypotheses.summary: SKU-409 (Apex Pro ANC Headphones) and SKU-412 (Ultra Soundbar Gen 2) reached 0 available units on Oct 16. These two items represent 41% of category revenue.
unresolvedQuestions: Why did reorder point fail to trigger automatic buffer stock safety alert?

hypotheses.title: Supplier Delay on Component PO-88321
hypotheses.summary: PO-88321 from Shenzhen Acoustics was scheduled for delivery on Oct 11, delayed 9 days to Oct 20 due to transshipment customs inspection in Long Beach.
unresolvedQuestions: Did the freight forwarder give advance notice before the carrier departed?

hypotheses.title: Consumer Demand Drop / Macro Market Shift
hypotheses.summary: Storefront sessions and product page impressions for the Audio category remained steady (+4.2% YoY). Cart-add conversion dropped sharply only after stockout badges appeared.

hypotheses.title: Promotional or Discounting Malfunction
hypotheses.summary: Marketing campaigns were active and coupon codes functioned properly. Paid search spend was unchanged.

evidence.title: Category Revenue Waterfall (Week 42)
evidence.sourceName: Zetaris / Postgres Sales DB
evidence.description: Audio category gross merchandise volume dropped from $767,000 (W41) to $518,500 (W42). 84% of the dollar shortfall is concentrated on SKU-409 and SKU-412.
evidence.confidenceBasis: Direct transactional reconciliation across 4,210 verified checkout logs.

evidence.title: WMS Inventory Depletion Timeline
evidence.sourceName: Zetaris / Manhattan WMS
evidence.description: SKU-409 reached zero inventory at 14:22 UTC on Wednesday Oct 16. SKU-412 ran out on Oct 17 08:15 UTC across all 3 US regional fulfillment hubs.
evidence.confidenceBasis: Physical warehouse scanned counts and inventory ledger balance logs.

evidence.title: Supplier EDI Delivery Exception PO-88321
evidence.sourceName: Zetaris / EDI 856 ASN Gateway
evidence.description: Shenzhen Acoustics shipment containing 3,000 units of SKU-409 and 1,500 units of SKU-412 held at Port of Long Beach. Original ETA was Oct 11; revised arrival Oct 20.
evidence.confidenceBasis: Direct carrier EDI 856 advance ship notice status updates.

evidence.title: Causal Linkage: Inbound Delay to Stockout Duration
evidence.sourceName: Nemotron Causal Analysis
evidence.description: Given average daily sales velocity of 180 units/day, safety stock was only sized for a 3-day buffer. A 9-day supplier delay mathematically guarantees a 5 to 6 day complete stockout.
evidence.confidenceBasis: Deterministic inventory burn rate vs actual delivery delta calculation.

evidence.title: Digital Storefront Traffic & Search Volume
evidence.sourceName: Zetaris / Clickstream Analytics
evidence.description: Total user visits to the Audio collection page rose +4.2% WoW. Bounce rate increased exclusively on out-of-stock product detail pages, proving high underlying demand.
evidence.confidenceBasis: Raw web server access logs and telemetry events.

evidence.title: Promotional Campaign Audit & Discount Verification
evidence.sourceName: Zetaris / Marketing DB
evidence.description: Autumn Audio 15% discount code remained active with 99.98% coupon API uptime. No pricing errors or broken links detected.
evidence.confidenceBasis: Coupon gateway server logs and Google Ads spend reconciliation.

report.executiveSummary: Investigation confirmed that the $248,500 (-32.4% WoW) revenue decline in Consumer Electronics / Audio Hardware during October 14 - October 21, 2026 (Week 42) was caused by physical inventory stockouts of SKU-409 and SKU-412. The stockouts were directly precipitated by a 9-day customs delay on inbound shipment PO-88321. Competing explanations including macro demand drop and promotional bugs were evaluated and contradicted by traffic and campaign uptime records.
report.primaryRootCause: Critical Stockout of Top-Tier Revenue Drivers: 0 available inventory due to supplier PO-88321 9-day port delay.
report.plausibilityRationale: Causal correlation established: SKU-409 and SKU-412 depleted on Oct 16. Checkout dropouts commenced immediately at 14:24 UTC. Web storefront demand was verified healthy (+4.2% traffic), proving lost sales were supply-constrained rather than demand-constrained.
limitationsAndMissingData: Carrier transshipment notice logs prior to Long Beach departure were unavailable in EDI 856.
Customer satisfaction surveys for cart abandonment during the out-of-stock window are pending analysis.
report.calculatedBusinessImpact: Estimated ongoing revenue loss of $42,000 per day until fulfillment centers are replenished with cleared units.
recommendedNextSteps: Authorize expedited air/cross-dock transport for cleared PO-88321 units from Long Beach to West & Midwest DCs (Expected recovery: 24h).
Raise dynamic ERP safety stock buffer parameter from 3 days to 10 days to absorb future ocean transshipment volatility.
Issue proactive stock-alert backorder vouchers to 382 abandoned checkout customers.

report.executiveSummary: Investigation confirmed that the $248,500 (-32.4% WoW) revenue decline in Consumer Electronics / Audio Hardware during October 14 - October 21, 2026 (Week 42) was caused by physical inventory stockouts of SKU-409 and SKU-412. The stockouts were directly precipitated by a 9-day customs delay on inbound shipment PO-88321. Competing explanations including macro demand drop and promotional bugs were evaluated and contradicted by traffic and campaign uptime records.
report.primaryRootCause: Critical Stockout of Top-Tier Revenue Drivers: 0 available inventory due to supplier PO-88321 9-day port delay.
report.plausibilityRationale: Causal correlation established: SKU-409 and SKU-412 depleted on Oct 16. Checkout dropouts commenced immediately at 14:24 UTC. Web storefront demand was verified healthy (+4.2% traffic), proving lost sales were supply-constrained rather than demand-constrained.
limitationsAndMissingData: Carrier transshipment notice logs prior to Long Beach departure were unavailable in EDI 856.
Customer satisfaction surveys for cart abandonment during the out-of-stock window are pending analysis.
report.calculatedBusinessImpact: Estimated ongoing revenue loss of $42,000 per day until fulfillment centers are replenished with cleared units.
recommendedNextSteps: Authorize expedited air/cross-dock transport for cleared PO-88321 units from Long Beach to West & Midwest DCs (Expected recovery: 24h).
Raise dynamic ERP safety stock buffer parameter from 3 days to 10 days to absorb future ocean transshipment volatility.
Issue proactive stock-alert backorder vouchers to 382 abandoned checkout customers.

inv-1792823061022.summary: Investigation confirmed that the $248,500 (-32.4% WoW) revenue decline in Consumer Electronics / Audio Hardware during October 14 - October 21, 2026 (Week 42) was caused by physical inventory stockouts of SKU-409 and SKU-412. The stockouts were directly precipitated by a 9-day customs delay on inbound shipment PO-88321. Competing explanations including macro demand drop and promotional bugs were evaluated and contradicted by traffic and campaign uptime records.

timeline.title: Incident Frame & Scope Defined
timeline.description: Scoped problem to Consumer Electronics / Audio Hardware during October 14 - October 21, 2026 (Week 42). Baseline delta: -32.4% WoW ($248,500 shortfall).

timeline.title: Cross-Source Schema Virtualization via Zetaris
timeline.description: Federated retrieval across Sales Transactions, Manhattan WMS, and EDI 856 ASN (Zetaris Cross-Source Data Virtualizer).

timeline.title: Competing Hypotheses Generated via Nemotron
timeline.description: Structured 4 competing hypotheses evaluated using NVIDIA Nemotron Reasoning Engine.

timeline.title: Evidence Gathering & Fact Distinction
timeline.description: Extracted source records. Tested web traffic (+4.2%), proving demand drop was contradicted.

timeline.title: Causal Chain Grounding & Action Formulation
timeline.description: Correlated Supplier PO-88321 delay (+9 days) directly to inventory depletion on Oct 16.

timeline.title: Human Review & Action Approval Gate
timeline.description: Recommended expedited supplier shipment awaiting human sign-off.

hypotheses.title: Critical Stockout of Top-Tier Revenue Drivers
hypotheses.summary: Flagship items SKU-409 and SKU-412 were depleted to zero available units across all 3 US regional fulfillment hubs starting Oct 16. These items account for 41% of category revenue.
unresolvedQuestions: Why did reorder point fail to trigger emergency buffer escalation before stock reached zero?

hypotheses.title: Supplier Delay on Component PO-88321
hypotheses.summary: PO-88321 from Shenzhen Acoustics (4,500 units) was scheduled for arrival on Oct 11, but delayed 9 days to Oct 20 at Port of Long Beach customs clearance.
unresolvedQuestions: Did the ocean carrier provide transshipment telemetry prior to port arrival?

hypotheses.title: Consumer Demand Drop / Macro Market Shift
hypotheses.summary: Investigated whether organic demand collapsed. Storefront visits to the Audio collection grew +4.2% WoW, proving underlying customer purchase intent remained strong.

hypotheses.title: Promotional Discounting or Coupon Failure
hypotheses.summary: Investigated potential checkout discount outage. Campaign coupon API maintained 99.98% uptime with regular ad spend, ruling out marketing error.

evidence.title: Category Revenue Waterfall (Week 42)
evidence.sourceName: Zetaris Virtualizer (Demo Fallback: Missing Live Credentials)
evidence.description: Audio category gross merchandise volume dropped from $767,000 to $518,500. 84% of the dollar shortfall is concentrated on SKU-409 and SKU-412.
evidence.confidenceBasis: Direct transactional reconciliation across verified checkout logs.

evidence.title: WMS Inventory Depletion Timeline
evidence.sourceName: Zetaris Virtualizer (Demo Fallback: Missing Live Credentials)
evidence.description: SKU-409 reached zero available inventory at 14:22 UTC on Oct 16. SKU-412 ran out on Oct 17 08:15 UTC across all 3 US regional fulfillment hubs.
evidence.confidenceBasis: Physical warehouse balance logs.

evidence.title: Supplier EDI Delivery Exception PO-88321
evidence.sourceName: Zetaris Virtualizer (Demo Fallback: Missing Live Credentials)
evidence.description: Shenzhen Acoustics shipment containing 3,000 units of SKU-409 and 1,500 units of SKU-412 held at Port of Long Beach customs. Original ETA was Oct 11; actual arrival Oct 20.
evidence.confidenceBasis: Direct carrier EDI 856 advance ship notice status updates.

evidence.title: Causal Linkage: Inbound Delay to Stockout Duration
evidence.sourceName: NVIDIA Nemotron Reasoning Engine
evidence.description: Given average daily sales velocity of 180 units/day, safety stock was only sized for a 3-day buffer. A 9-day supplier delay mathematically guarantees a 5 to 6 day complete stockout.
evidence.confidenceBasis: Deterministic inventory burn rate vs actual delivery delta calculation.

evidence.title: Digital Storefront Traffic & Search Volume
evidence.sourceName: Zetaris Federated Virtualizer -> Web Clickstream Lake
evidence.description: Total visits to the Audio collection page rose +4.2% WoW. Bounce rate increased exclusively on out-of-stock product detail pages, proving high underlying customer demand.
evidence.confidenceBasis: Raw web server access logs and telemetry events.

evidence.title: Promotional Campaign Audit & Discount Verification
evidence.sourceName: Zetaris Federated Virtualizer -> Marketing Promo Engine
evidence.description: Autumn Audio 15% discount code remained active with 99.98% coupon API uptime. No pricing errors or broken links detected.
evidence.confidenceBasis: Coupon gateway server logs and Google Ads spend reconciliation.

details.title: Weekly Sales Shortfall: $248,500
details.description: Revenue anomaly in Consumer Electronics / Audio Hardware during October 14 - October 21, 2026 (Week 42).

details.title: SKU-409 (Flagship Noise-Canceling)
details.description: Represents 28% of category volume. Reached zero stock on Oct 16.

details.title: SKU-412 (Ultra Soundbar Gen 2)
details.description: Represents 13% of category volume. Reached zero stock on Oct 17.

details.title: Depleted Warehouse Balance
details.description: All 3 fulfillment centers had 0 inventory available for purchase.

details.title: Inbound PO-88321 Port Customs Delay
details.description: 4,500 units delayed at Long Beach Port customs clearance until Oct 20.

details.title: Market Demand Collapse (Contradicted)
details.description: Contradicted by web analytics: traffic rose +4.2% YoY with high intent.

details.title: Corrective Action Formulation
details.description: Expedite inbound cross-dock delivery & raise safety stock threshold from 3 to 10 days.

actions.title: Expedite Air-Freight Transit for Inbound PO-88321 Cross-Dock
actions.rationale: PO-88321 cleared customs on Oct 19. Authorizing emergency cross-dock distribution directly to West & Midwest DCs recovers stock in 24 hours instead of 5 days ground freight.
actions.expectedOutcome: Restores 4,500 active units of SKU-409 & SKU-412 across fulfillment centers, preventing an estimated $42,000/day in continued lost sales.
actions.risksAndLimitations: Expedited cross-dock fee costs $6,400. Reclaims estimated $84,000 in net gross margin over 48 hours.
actions.verificationMethod: Monitor WMS available-to-promise inventory levels within 24 hours of cross-dock delivery scan.

actions.title: Update Dynamic Safety Stock Threshold from 3 to 10 Days in ERP
actions.rationale: Current 3-day buffer assumption failed when port lead-times fluctuated. Expanding buffer prevents future single-supplier vulnerability.
actions.expectedOutcome: Automates replenishment reorders 7 days earlier during peak ocean transit delays.
actions.risksAndLimitations: Increases holding capital by ~$18,500 per SKU across the audio category.
actions.verificationMethod: Verify MRP (Material Requirements Planning) safety-stock parameter table reflects 10-day buffer.

report.executiveSummary: Investigation confirmed that the $248,500 (-32.4% WoW) revenue decline in Consumer Electronics / Audio Hardware during October 14 - October 21, 2026 (Week 42) was caused by physical inventory stockouts of SKU-409 and SKU-412. The stockouts were directly precipitated by a 9-day customs delay on inbound shipment PO-88321. Competing explanations including macro demand drop and promotional bugs were evaluated and contradicted by traffic and campaign uptime records.
report.primaryRootCause: Critical Stockout of Top-Tier Revenue Drivers: 0 available inventory due to supplier PO-88321 9-day port delay.
report.plausibilityRationale: Causal correlation established: SKU-409 and SKU-412 depleted on Oct 16. Checkout dropouts commenced immediately at 14:24 UTC. Web storefront demand was verified healthy (+4.2% traffic), proving lost sales were supply-constrained rather than demand-constrained.
limitationsAndMissingData: Carrier transshipment notice logs prior to Long Beach departure were unavailable in EDI 856.
Customer satisfaction surveys for cart abandonment during the out-of-stock window are pending analysis.
report.calculatedBusinessImpact: Estimated ongoing revenue loss of $42,000 per day until fulfillment centers are replenished with cleared units.
recommendedNextSteps: Authorize expedited air/cross-dock transport for cleared PO-88321 units from Long Beach to West & Midwest DCs (Expected recovery: 24h).
Raise dynamic ERP safety stock buffer parameter from 3 days to 10 days to absorb future ocean transshipment volatility.
Issue proactive stock-alert backorder vouchers to 382 abandoned checkout customers.

report.executiveSummary: Investigation confirmed that the $248,500 (-32.4% WoW) revenue decline in Consumer Electronics / Audio Hardware during October 14 - October 21, 2026 (Week 42) was caused by physical inventory stockouts of SKU-409 and SKU-412. The stockouts were directly precipitated by a 9-day customs delay on inbound shipment PO-88321. Competing explanations including macro demand drop and promotional bugs were evaluated and contradicted by traffic and campaign uptime records.
report.primaryRootCause: Critical Stockout of Top-Tier Revenue Drivers: 0 available inventory due to supplier PO-88321 9-day port delay.
report.plausibilityRationale: Causal correlation established: SKU-409 and SKU-412 depleted on Oct 16. Checkout dropouts commenced immediately at 14:24 UTC. Web storefront demand was verified healthy (+4.2% traffic), proving lost sales were supply-constrained rather than demand-constrained.
limitationsAndMissingData: Carrier transshipment notice logs prior to Long Beach departure were unavailable in EDI 856.
Customer satisfaction surveys for cart abandonment during the out-of-stock window are pending analysis.
report.calculatedBusinessImpact: Estimated ongoing revenue loss of $42,000 per day until fulfillment centers are replenished with cleared units.
recommendedNextSteps: Authorize expedited air/cross-dock transport for cleared PO-88321 units from Long Beach to West & Midwest DCs (Expected recovery: 24h).
Raise dynamic ERP safety stock buffer parameter from 3 days to 10 days to absorb future ocean transshipment volatility.
Issue proactive stock-alert backorder vouchers to 382 abandoned checkout customers.

report.executiveSummary: Investigation confirmed that the $248,500 (-32.4% WoW) revenue decline in Consumer Electronics / Audio Hardware during October 14 - October 21, 2026 (Week 42) was caused by physical inventory stockouts of SKU-409 and SKU-412. The stockouts were directly precipitated by a 9-day customs delay on inbound shipment PO-88321. Competing explanations including macro demand drop and promotional bugs were evaluated and contradicted by traffic and campaign uptime records.
report.primaryRootCause: Critical Stockout of Top-Tier Revenue Drivers: 0 available inventory due to supplier PO-88321 9-day port delay.
report.plausibilityRationale: Causal correlation established: SKU-409 and SKU-412 depleted on Oct 16. Checkout dropouts commenced immediately at 14:24 UTC. Web storefront demand was verified healthy (+4.2% traffic), proving lost sales were supply-constrained rather than demand-constrained.
limitationsAndMissingData: Carrier transshipment notice logs prior to Long Beach departure were unavailable in EDI 856.
Customer satisfaction surveys for cart abandonment during the out-of-stock window are pending analysis.
report.calculatedBusinessImpact: Estimated ongoing revenue loss of $42,000 per day until fulfillment centers are replenished with cleared units.
recommendedNextSteps: Authorize expedited air/cross-dock transport for cleared PO-88321 units from Long Beach to West & Midwest DCs (Expected recovery: 24h).
Raise dynamic ERP safety stock buffer parameter from 3 days to 10 days to absorb future ocean transshipment volatility.
Issue proactive stock-alert backorder vouchers to 382 abandoned checkout customers.

report.executiveSummary: Investigation confirmed that the $248,500 (-32.4% WoW) revenue decline in Consumer Electronics / Audio Hardware during October 14 - October 21, 2026 (Week 42) was caused by physical inventory stockouts of SKU-409 and SKU-412. Competing explanations including macro demand drop and promotional bugs were evaluated and contradicted by traffic and campaign uptime records.
report.primaryRootCause: Critical Stockout of Top-Tier Revenue Drivers: 0 available inventory due to supplier PO-88321 9-day port delay.

limitationsAndMissingData: Carrier transshipment notice logs prior to Long Beach departure were unavailable in EDI 856.
Customer satisfaction surveys for cart abandonment during the out-of-stock window are pending analysis.
report.calculatedBusinessImpact: Estimated ongoing revenue loss of $42,000 per day until fulfillment centers are replenished with cleared units.
recommendedNextSteps: Authorize expedited air/cross-dock transport for cleared PO-88321 units from Long Beach to West & Midwest DCs (Expected recovery: 24h).
Raise dynamic ERP safety stock buffer parameter from 3 days to 10 days to absorb future ocean transshipment volatility.
Issue proactive stock-alert backorder vouchers to 382 abandoned checkout customers.
